status: executed retrospective homogeneous-catalogue field spike; no local curl or crease detected

authority.catalogue: Hunt and Reffert 2023 corrected Gaia DR3 members

frozenSelection.rvGate: finite RV and e_RV<=5 km/s; then 3 robust residual sigmas
frozenSelection.selectionTiming: cluster sample and quality gates fixed from catalogue metadata before any director estimates were inspected

method.perCluster: fit common ICRS space velocity from proper motions and parallaxes; subtract predicted astrometric RV from Gaia RV; regress robust residuals on 3-D inverse-parallax Cartesian position
method.comparison: leave one entire cluster out; compare flat mean-Q, smooth affine Q(x), and nested two-region plane split
method.boundary: ordinary residual-gradient directors are proxies only; no lift to a four-dimensional normal field is supplied

result.reason: the flat model has the lowest held-out error; several cluster directors are fold-unstable; ordinary 3-D directors have no source-derived lift to four-dimensional normals
result.nextGate: improve per-cluster direction stability with full astrometric covariance and independent spectroscopy, then repeat on a larger preregistered spatial sample before attempting derivative, holonomy or integrability estimates
